content:
tara: Hey team — running the quickstart with a fresh workspace and hitting a weird sequence. First request returns 402 Payment Required, then SDK retries bubble up a 502. Anyone seen billing gating flip like this?

sam_devex: Can you paste the curl output and which SDK/lang?

tara: Node SDK v0.12.1 but repros with curl too. Curl dump: 

```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 15:02:31 GMT
x-workspace-status: billing_required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"payment_required","doc":"https://redwood.ai/docs/billing"}

# immediate retry by SDK follows and gets:
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
...
```

tara: header `x-workspace-status: billing_required` is present on the 402. Strange that the SDK retries instead of surfacing the billing response as terminal.

ira_ops: Which SDK retry policy? latest node defaults to 2 retries on 5xx, but 402 should be treated as terminal. Maybe middleware is converting 402 -> 5xx?

sam_devex: Can you share the exact Node code (tiny) you used?

tara: Sure: 

```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'hi' });
```

michael: Hmm, SDK shouldn't retry on 4xx. @devex-bot can you run a quick audit on the request pipeline logs for tara's workspace (ws_01EXAMPLEx)?

devex-bot: audit queued — will post results in this thread :gear: (ETA 90s)

sam_devex: In the meantime, tara — can you confirm workspace billing setup in the console? New orgs sometimes have invoices pending that set `billing_required` flag.

tara: Console shows "Billing: not enabled" and there's a toast to add a card. But the user flow created the workspace via SSO and they expected trial credits.

ira_ops: Two hypotheses: 1) control-plane returning 402 and edge is respecting it but our client-side retry wrapper is built to retry on anything non-200 (bug), or 2) an edge proxy is swallowing the 402 and translating to 502 when proxying to runtime for the retry.

sam_devex: If it's (1) the fix is in SDK: treat 4xx as terminal unless explicitly whitelisted. If (2) we need to look at edge logs.

devex-bot: audit result: request path shows initial response 402 from control-plane with header `x-workspace-status: billing_required`. Retry attempt reached edge with missing auth header (proxy drop) and resulted in 502 from runtime. Full trace id: tr_2111111111-xy.

michael: Good find. That suggests the SDK retries but a transient header/proxy mismatch causes 502 — we should stop retrying on 4xx and also harden header preservation on the edge.

tara: For immediate unblock, can we short-circuit the SDK to surface 402 to the user? I can ship a patch in my local copy for the team to cherry-pick into 0.12.2.

sam_devex: Yes please. Patch checklist: detect status >=400 && status <500 -> throw BillingError with original body; no retry. Add unit test for 402. Also add telemetry to capture `x-workspace-status` on failures.

ira_ops: I'll open an edge ticket to check header forwarding rules. I'll include the trace id.

tara: Thanks — will open the PR in ~20m and ping here. :thumbsup:

sam_devex: Thanks — also adding doc note for onboarding: if console shows "Billing: not enabled" the quickstart will fail with 402 instead of the usual 403/401 messages. We'll clarify messaging.

michael: Follow-ups: (a) SDK fix (b) edge header fix (c) doc clar. Assigning owners after PR and ticket.

tara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 (draft). Tests added.

devex-bot: linked PR noted. Will update thread when edge ticket is created.

sam_devex: Nice! If anyone else hits this, mention this thread or escalate to #eng-runtime if you see trace ids with dropped auth header.

michael: resolved for now — keeping open until edge ticket and SDK patch merged.
